village.title: Skillstreak Village
village.intro: Here you see team names and sports. No players, no numbers.
village.empty: No teams are shown here right now.
village.loadError: Couldn't load the village. Check your connection.
village.trainNowTitle: Want to wake up the arena today?
village.trainNowBody: Do a session whenever suits you – it adds points to your team's World Championship Gold.

optIn.onTitle: Your team is in the village
optIn.onBody: Other teams in the village only see your team name and sport – no players, photos, clips or chat.
optIn.offTitle: Your team is not in the village
optIn.offBodyCaptain: As captain, you decide. Talk to your coach and the parents first. If you join, other teams in the village see your team name and sport – nothing else. Until then you won't see other teams' names either.
optIn.offBodyPlayer: Other teams can't see your team, and you can't see their names. The captain can choose to join the village.
optIn.confirmBody: Other teams in the village will see your team name and sport. Have you talked to your coach and the parents?

village.previewBanner: Preview – only you can see this. The teams below are made up, and your team cannot join until the village opens.
